issue.ray5-address: Invalid Ray5 address. Use a private IPv4 address and valid ports.
issue.ray5-connection: Ray5 unreachable or disconnected. Check its address, Wi-Fi and TCP/ESP3D mode.
issue.ray5-report: No usable GRBL status received. An open port or HTTP response is insufficient; check the firmware mode and ports.
issue.ray5-stale: Ray5 stopped reporting fresh status. Previous readings discarded.
issue.ray5-access: ESP3D access denied. This pilot does not support its authentication yet.
issue.ray5-alarm: Ray5 reports a GRBL alarm. No automatic unlock.
issue.ray5-door: The controller reports a door/interlock condition.
issue.ray5-busy: The controller reports jogging, homing or check mode.
issue.prusalink-access: Access denied. Check the PrusaLink API key.
issue.prusalink-response: PrusaLink did not return usable status.
issue.octoprint-access: Access denied. Check the OctoPrint API key and its permissions.
issue.octoprint-response: The OctoPrint API did not return usable status.
issue.octoprint-disconnected: OctoPrint is reachable, but the printer is disconnected.
issue.xtool-connection: FabCore cannot reach the M2 on port 28900.
issue.xtool-authorization: The M2 requires authorization. Use “Pair M2”.
issue.xtool-pairing-timeout: Pairing timed out. Try again and confirm on the M2.
issue.xtool-pairing-busy: Pairing is unavailable. Close xTool Studio if it is connected, then try again.
issue.xtool-protocol: The M2 did not return a compatible WS-V2 status.
issue.xtool-identity: The M2 certificate or serial number changed.
issue.cc1-discovery: CC1 discovery failed. Check the IP or enter the MainboardID.
issue.cc1-connection: FabCore cannot reach the CC1 on port 3030.
issue.cc1-report: No SDCP status matches this CC1. Check the MainboardID.
issue.elegoo-access: CC2 access denied. Check the LAN access code.
issue.elegoo-info: CC2 identity unavailable. Check the address and LAN Only mode.
issue.elegoo-identity: This address belongs to another printer.
issue.elegoo-register: The CC2 rejected the MQTT session.
issue.elegoo-report: No usable CC2 status was received.
issue.elegoo-print: The CC2 reports a print error.
issue.elegoo-connection: FabCore cannot reach the CC2. Check local ports 80 and 1883 and LAN Only mode.
issue.bambu-access: MQTT access denied. Check the LAN access code.
issue.bambu-tls: The P2S certificate does not match the serial number or expected authority.
issue.bambu-report: The P2S connected but sent no usable status. Check its serial number and LAN settings.
issue.bambu-print: The P2S reports a print error.
issue.bambu-connection: FabCore cannot reach the P2S on MQTT port 8883.
issue.access: Moonraker access denied. Check the API key or network authorization.

diagnostic.registered: MQTT session accepted by the printer.
diagnostic.retry: MQTT connection closed. A retry is scheduled.
diagnostic.no-stream: No image received when starting the stream.
diagnostic.identity: The machine identity could not be confirmed.
diagnostic.invalid-stream: The camera returned an incompatible response.
diagnostic.confirmed: Heating setpoint confirmed by the machine.
diagnostic.heater-unconfirmed: Heating setpoint not confirmed despite acknowledgement.
